retainedPrinciples: Keep DWBOT_BRANCH_CHARTER.md and the nine mandatory fields.
Keep the current source code, tests, runtime assets, current user manuals, source baseline, RC3 provenance archive, and the 56-image review workbook.
Keep the original user-supplied OCR implementation text and Discord scoring/workbook messages under docs/source-inputs/.
Keep testdata/ground-truth/imagesF-63-working-ground-truth-v6.json and related screenshot sources as optional labelled-evaluation inputs; they are not formal release gates.
Do not modify or merge into main.
binaryInspectionLimit: The GitHub repository interface exposed binary blobs as opaque objects rather than decoded document contents. Deletion was limited to superseded draft/QA/release directories, duplicate backups/exports, stale gate artifacts, and clearly unrelated auxiliary files. Potentially relevant opaque sources (the 56-image review workbook, inventory JSON files, tournament DOCX source documents, current workbook, original source baseline, and RC3 archive) were retained. This manifest records original blob hashes and sizes; it does not claim every removed binary was text-extracted.
